ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, $AB = 8$, $BC = 14$, points $D$ and $E$ are the midpoints of sides $AB$ and $AC$ respectively, point $F$ is on $DE$, and $\angle AFB = 90^\circ$. What is the length of $EF$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since points D and E are the midpoints of sides AB and AC respectively,\\
DE is the midline of $\triangle ABC$,\\
since BC=14,\\
thus DE=$\frac{1}{2}$BC=$\frac{1}{2} \times 14=7$.\\
Since $\angle$AFB=$90^\circ$ and D is the midpoint of AB, with AB=8,\\
thus DF=$\frac{1}{2}$AB=$\frac{1}{2} \times 8=4$,\\
thus $EF=DE$-$DF=7$-$4=\boxed{3}$.
